summary: Community installations get a clear message on Pro-only pages, and the Community edition has a new licence.

fixes.title: Clear message on Pro pages in Community
fixes.text: On a Community installation, Pro-only pages show one plain line: This is part of PIM Manager Pro. Your installation is Community.

fixes.title: New Community licence
fixes.text: The Community edition is now licensed under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0. The Pro terms ship only in the Pro package.
